stories.story: As a visitor, I can create an account
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a new email and password, when I register, then my account exists and I land on Login

stories.story: As a reader, I can sign in
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a wrong password, when I sign in, then I stay on Login with an error

stories.story: As a reader, my book pages are visible only when I am signed in
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given I am signed out, when I open /books, then I am sent to Login

stories.story: As a reader, I can see my books
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given another reader owns a book, when I open My Books, then it is not listed

stories.story: As a reader, I can add a book
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a title, author and ISBN, when I save, then the book is listed on My Books

stories.story: As a reader, I can sign out
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given I signed out, when I open /books, then I am sent to Login

stories.story: As a reader, I can view a book's details
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a book id that does not exist, when I open it, then I see Book not found

stories.story: As a reader, I can delete a book
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given another reader's book, when I delete it, then nothing is deleted

stories.story: As a reader, I see clear empty and error states
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given the books cannot load, when I open My Books, then I see an error and a Try again button

stories.story: As a reader, I can change a book's reading status
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a status that is not allowed, when I save, then it is not changed

stories.story: As a developer, I have automated tests for sign-in and the book flow
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given the test suite, when it runs, then it rejects a wrong password and another reader's book

stories.story: As a reader, I can rate and review a book
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a rating outside 1 to 5, when I save, then no review is saved and I see an error

stories.story: As a reader, I can see my reviews on a book
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a book with no reviews, when I open it, then I see No reviews yet
